{{Quote|We need sunfruit liqueur. And, doubtless, some of the good stuff from a tropical world that knows how to turn it out, not one of the Coruscant synthetics.|[[Squeaky (droid)|Squeaky]]|<ref name="X-Wing: Iron Fist">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>}}
'''Sunfruit liqueur''' was a type of [[Liqueur/Legends|liqueur]] derived from [[sunfruit]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Carmal]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lavisar/Legends|Lavisar]] enjoyed sunfruit liqueur.
